select DATE_FORMAT(apply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count from adopt_application where apply_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) group by date order by date asc
select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count from rescue where create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) group by date order by date asc
select c.name as name, count(p.id) as value from pet p left join pet_category c on p.category_id = c.id group by c.id, c.name
select status as name, count(*) as value from adopt_application group by status
